evaluation_constraints.name: ck_e04_default_source
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_kind <> 'e10'::text) OR (evaluation_role <> 'calibration_default'::text) OR ((threshold_source = 'default'::text) AND (threshold_used = 0.5) AND (calibration_id IS NULL))))

evaluation_constraints.name: ck_e04_selected_source
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_kind <> 'e10'::text) OR (evaluation_role <> 'calibration_selected'::text) OR ((threshold_source = 'validation_calibration'::text) AND (calibration_id IS NOT NULL))))

evaluation_constraints.name: ck_v2_evaluation_scope
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((split = 'test'::text) AND (purpose = 'final'::text) AND (evaluation_role = 'final_test'::text)) OR ((split = ANY (ARRAY['train'::text, 'val'::text])) AND (purpose = 'development'::text) AND (evaluation_role = ANY (ARRAY['training_validation_final'::text, 'development'::text, 'calibration_default'::text, 'calibration_selected'::text]))) OR ((split = 'external'::text) AND (purpose = 'complementary'::text) AND (evaluation_role = 'external_complementary'::text))))

evaluation_constraints.name: ck_v2_external_provenance
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK (((split <> 'external'::text) OR ((dataset_origin_id IS NOT NULL) AND (dataset_origin_role IS NOT NULL) AND (population_manifest_uri IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(population_manifest_uri)) > 0) AND (population_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (population_manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (dataset_provenance_uri IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(dataset_provenance_uri)) > 0) AND (dataset_provenance_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (dataset_provenance_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (source_kind = ANY (ARRAY['legacy'::text, 'external_record'::text])) AND (length(btrim(source_record_key)) > 0) AND (length(btrim(source_record_phase)) > 0))))

evaluation_constraints.name: fk_evaluation_e10_record
evaluation_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, event_kind, event_phase, event_key) REFERENCES train_execution_records(run_id, kind, phase, record_key) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

evaluation_constraints.name: fk_v2_evaluation_dataset_origin
evaluation_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (dataset_version_id, dataset_origin_id, dataset_origin_role) REFERENCES dataset_version_sources(dataset_version_id, dataset_id, role) ON DELETE RESTRICT

evaluation_constraints.name: v2_evaluations_check_3b1acb9be108
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_kind = 'e10'::text) AND (event_kind = 'e10_event'::text) AND (event_phase = 'run_event_v1'::text) AND (event_key = (source_event_id)::text) AND (event_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (event_phase IS NOT NULL) AND (event_key IS NOT NULL)) OR ((source_kind <> 'e10'::text) AND (event_kind IS NULL) AND (event_phase IS NULL) AND (event_key IS NULL))))

evaluation_constraints.name: v2_evaluations_check_88394215eb49
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_kind = 'e10'::text) AND (source_event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_assessment_attempt_id IS NULL)) OR ((source_kind = 'assessment'::text) AND (source_event_id IS NULL) AND (source_assessment_attempt_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((source_kind = ANY (ARRAY['legacy'::text, 'external_record'::text])) AND (source_event_id IS NULL) AND (source_assessment_attempt_id IS NULL))))

evaluation_constraints.name: v2_evaluations_check_d2a4e9ce706e
evaluation_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((threshold_source = 'default'::text) AND (threshold_used = 0.5) AND (calibration_id IS NULL)) OR ((threshold_source = 'validation_calibration'::text) AND (calibration_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((threshold_source = 'protocol_numeric'::text) AND (calibration_id IS NULL))))

evaluation_constraints.name: v2_evaluations_foreign_0baa7d166e2f
evaluation_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (calibration_id) REFERENCES run_threshold_calibration(run_threshold_calibration_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

evaluation_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (dataset_version_id) REFERENCES dataset_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

calibration_indexes.name: uq_e04_contract_role
calibration_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_e04_contract_role ON public.evaluations USING btree (run_id, training_run_id, model_version_id, checkpoint_artifact_id, dataset_version_id, population_hash, protocol_version, protocol_hash, input_contract_hash, evaluation_role) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE ((source_kind = 'e10'::text) AND (evaluation_role = ANY (ARRAY['calibration_default'::text, 'calibration_selected'::text])))

calibration_indexes.name: uq_e04_event_role
calibration_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_e04_event_role ON public.evaluations USING btree (source_event_id, evaluation_role) WHERE ((source_kind = 'e10'::text) AND (evaluation_role = ANY (ARRAY['calibration_default'::text, 'calibration_selected'::text])))
